newsitem.title: UK: Panamaxes help BFI up seven.
newsitem.headline: Panamaxes help BFI up seven.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index was up seven on Monday at 1374 points as Panamax rates generally continued to progress especially for modern types from the Atlantic to the Far East.

Hanjin fixed Hai Ji 70,000 dwt delivery US Gulf mid-Feb trip Japan at $14,500 daily plus $300,000 bonus. Egyptian charterers have been active in the grain trades from Australia and the Continent, and brokers said they had heard reports of period fixtures of Panamaxes both East and West at steady levels.
Caper rates continue to soften with reports that 150,000 tonnes iron ore Tubarao/Rotterdam has been fixed by German charterers at $5.75.
